name: Tengoku.Compply.cast_eq_cast_iff
statement:
theorem Tengoku.Compply.cast_eq_cast_iff {α β γ : Sort u} {h : α = γ} {h' : β = γ} {a : α} {b : β} :
    cast h a = cast h' b ↔ a = cast (h'.trans h.symm) b

name: Tengoku.Compply.cast_symm
statement:
theorem Tengoku.Compply.cast_symm {α β : Sort u} {h : α = β} {a : α} {b : β} :
    cast h a = b ↔ a = cast h.symm b

name: Tengoku.Compply.dcast_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Tengoku.Compply.dcast_eq : dcast (Eq.refl a) b = b

name: Tengoku.Compply.dcast_eq_dcast_iff
statement:
theorem Tengoku.Compply.dcast_eq_dcast_iff (h : a = a'') (h' : a' = a'') :
    dcast h b = dcast h' b' ↔ b = dcast (h'.trans h.symm) b'

name: Tengoku.Compply.dcast_eq_root_cast
statement: theorem Tengoku.Compply.dcast_eq_root_cast (h : a = a') : dcast h b = _root_.cast (congrArg β h) b

name: Tengoku.Compply.dcast_fun
statement:
theorem Tengoku.Compply.dcast_fun {γ : (a : α) → β a → Sort*} {f : (b : β a) → γ a b} :
    f (dcast rfl b) = dcast (α := β a) (β := γ a) dcast_eq.symm (f b)

name: Tengoku.Compply.dcast_symm
statement: theorem Tengoku.Compply.dcast_symm (ha : a = a') (hb : dcast ha b = b') : dcast (ha.symm) b' = b

name: Tengoku.Compply.dcast_trans
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Tengoku.Compply.dcast_trans (h : a = a') (h' : a' = a'') :
    dcast h' (dcast h b) = dcast (h.trans h') b

name: Tengoku.Compply.heq_of_dcast
statement: theorem Tengoku.Compply.heq_of_dcast (ha : a = a') (hb : dcast ha b = b') : HEq b b'

name: Tengoku.Compply.AlgebraTower.algebraMap_self
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Tengoku.Compply.AlgebraTower.algebraMap_self (i : ι) (h : i ≤ i) :
    AlgebraTower.algebraMap (AT := A) i i h = RingHom.id (A i)

name: Tengoku.Compply.AlgebraTower.algebraMap_self_apply
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Compply.AlgebraTower.algebraMap_self_apply (i : ι) (h : i ≤ i) (x : A i) :
    AlgebraTower.algebraMap (AT := A) i i h x = x

name: Tengoku.Compply.AlgebraTowerEquiv.commutesRight'
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Compply.AlgebraTowerEquiv.commutesRight' (e : AlgebraTowerEquiv A B)
    {i j : ι} (h : i ≤ j) (r : B i) :
  AlgebraTower.algebraMap (AT:=A) (i:=i) (j:=j) (h:=h) ((e.toRingEquiv i).symm r) =
  (e.toRingEquiv j).symm (AlgebraTower.algebraMap (AT:=B) (i:=i) (j:=j) (h:=h) r)

name: Field.mod_eq_zero
statement:
lemma Field.mod_eq_zero {K : Type u} [Field K] (a b : K) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    a % b = 0

name: Tengoku.Compply.coeffs_of_comp_minus_x
statement:
theorem Tengoku.Compply.coeffs_of_comp_minus_x {f : Polynomial F} {n : ℕ} :
    (f.comp (-X)).coeff n = if Even n then f.coeff n else -f.coeff n

name: Tengoku.Compply.comp_x_square_coeff
statement:
theorem Tengoku.Compply.comp_x_square_coeff {f : Polynomial F} {n : ℕ} :
    (f.comp (X * X)).coeff n = if Even n then f.coeff (n / 2) else 0

name: Tengoku.Compply.eq_poly_deg_one
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Compply.eq_poly_deg_one {a b c d : F} {x₁ x₂ : F}
    (h1 : a + b * x₁ = c + d * x₁)
    (h2 : a + b * x₂ = c + d * x₂)
    (h1_2 : x₁ ≠ x₂) :
    Polynomial.C a + Polynomial.C b * Polynomial.X =
      Polynomial.C c + Polynomial.C d * Polynomial.X

name: Tengoku.Compply.inv_two_mul_two
statement:

lemma Tengoku.Compply.inv_two_mul_two : 2⁻¹ * (2 : F) = 1

statement:

lemma Tengoku.Compply.two_mul_inv_two : (2 : F) * 2⁻¹ = 1

name: Basis.baseChangeRight_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Basis.baseChangeRight_apply (b : Basis ι K Left) (i : ι) :
    (Basis.baseChangeRight (b:=b) (Right:=Right)) i = b i ⊗ₜ[K] 1

name: Basis.baseChangeRight_repr_tmul
statement:
lemma Basis.baseChangeRight_repr_tmul (b : Basis ι K Left) (x y i) :
    (Basis.baseChangeRight (b:=b) (Right:=Right)).repr (x ⊗ₜ y) i = b.repr x i • y

name: Tengoku.Compply.comm_map_smul_add
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Compply.comm_map_smul_add (s : Right) (x y : Right ⊗[K] Left)
    (hx : e (s • x) = s • (e x)) (hy : e (s • y) = s • (e y)) :
    e (s • x) + e (s • y) = s • e x + s • e y

name: Tengoku.Compply.comm_map_smul_tmul
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Compply.comm_map_smul_tmul (s s' : Right) (m : Left) :
    e (s • (s' ⊗ₜ[K] m)) = s • (e (s' ⊗ₜ[K] m))

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.Trim.canonical_empty
statement: theorem canonical_empty [Zero R] [BEq R] : (mk (R := R) #[]).trim = #[]

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.Trim.canonical_ext
statement:
theorem canonical_ext [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]
    {p q : CPolynomial.Raw R} (hp : p.trim = p) (hq : q.trim = q) :
    equiv p q → p = q

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.Trim.canonical_iff
statement:
theorem canonical_iff [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] {p : CPolynomial.Raw R} :
    p.trim = p ↔ IsCanonical p

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.Trim.canonical_nonempty_iff
statement:
theorem canonical_nonempty_iff [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]
    {p : CPolynomial.Raw R} (hp : p.size > 0) :
    p.trim = p ↔ p.lastNonzero = some ⟨ p.size - 1, Nat.pred_lt_self hp ⟩

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.Trim.canonical_of_size_zero
statement:
theorem canonical_of_size_zero [Zero R] [BEq R] {p : CPolynomial.Raw R} :
    p.size = 0 → p.trim = p

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.Trim.coeff_eq_coeff
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_coeff [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]
    (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) (i : ℕ) :
    p.trim.coeff i = p.coeff i

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.Trim.coeff_eq_getElem
statement:
lemma coeff_eq_getElem [Zero Q] {p : CPolynomial.Raw Q} {i} (hp : i < p.size) :
    p.coeff i = p[i]

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.Trim.coeff_eq_getElem_of_lt
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_getElem_of_lt [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]
    {p : CPolynomial.Raw R} {i} (hi : i < p.size) :
    p.trim.coeff i = p[i]

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.Trim.coeff_eq_zero
statement:
lemma coeff_eq_zero [Zero Q] {p : CPolynomial.Raw Q} :
    (∀ i, (hi : i < p.size) → p[i] = 0) ↔ ∀ i, p.coeff i = 0

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.Trim.elim
statement:
theorem elim [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) :
    (p.trim = #[] ∧  (∀ i, (hi : i < p.size) → p[i] = 0))
    ∨ (∃ k : Fin p.size,
        p.trim = p.extract 0 (k + 1)
      ∧ p[k] ≠ 0
      ∧ (∀ j : ℕ, (hj : j < p.size) → j > k → p[j] = 0))

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.Trim.eq_degree_of_equiv
statement:
lemma eq_degree_of_equiv [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] {p q : CPolynomial.Raw R} :
    equiv p q → p.degree = q.degree

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.Trim.eq_of_equiv
statement:
theorem eq_of_equiv [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] {p q : CPolynomial.Raw R} :
    equiv p q → p.trim = q.trim

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.Trim.induct
statement:
theorem induct [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] {motive : CPolynomial.Raw R → Prop}
    (case1 : ∀ p, p.trim = #[] → (∀ i, (hi : i < p.size) → p[i] = 0) → motive p)
  (case2 : ∀ p : CPolynomial.Raw R, ∀ k : Fin p.size, p.trim = p.extract 0 (k + 1)
    → p[k] ≠ 0 → (∀ j : ℕ, (hj : j < p.size) → j > k → p[j] = 0) → motive p)
  (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) : motive p

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.Trim.isCanonical_empty
statement: theorem isCanonical_empty [Zero R] : IsCanonical (mk (R := R) #[])

CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.Trim.isCanonical_iff_size_eq_zero_or_getLastD_ne_zero
statement:
theorem isCanonical_iff_size_eq_zero_or_getLastD_ne_zero [Zero R]

theorem isCanonical_iff_trim_eq [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.Trim.isCanonical_of_trim_eq
statement:
theorem isCanonical_of_trim_eq [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.Trim.lastNonzero_induct
statement:
theorem lastNonzero_induct [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] {motive : CPolynomial.Raw R → Prop}
    (case1 : ∀ p, p.lastNonzero = none → (∀ i, (hi : i < p.size) → p[i] = 0) → motive p)
  (case2 : ∀ p : CPolynomial.Raw R, ∀ k : Fin p.size, p.lastNonzero = some k → p[k] ≠ 0 →
    (∀ j : ℕ, (hj : j < p.size) → j > k → p[j] = 0) → motive p)
  (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) : motive p

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.Trim.lastNonzero_last_iff
statement:
theorem lastNonzero_last_iff [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]
    {p : CPolynomial.Raw R} (hp : p.size > 0) :
    p.lastNonzero = some ⟨ p.size - 1, Nat.pred_lt_self hp ⟩ ↔ p.getLast hp ≠ 0

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.Trim.lastNonzero_none
statement:
theorem lastNonzero_none [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] {p : CPolynomial.Raw R} :
    (∀ i, (hi : i < p.size) → p[i] = 0) → p.lastNonzero = none

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.Trim.lastNonzero_some
statement:
theorem lastNonzero_some [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]
    {p : CPolynomial.Raw R} {i} (hi : i < p.size)
    (h : p[i] ≠ 0) : ∃ k, p.lastNonzero = some k

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.Trim.lastNonzero_some_iff
statement:
theorem lastNonzero_some_iff [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] {p : CPolynomial.Raw R} {k} :
    p.lastNonzero = some k ↔ (p[k] ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ j, (hj : j < p.size) → j > k → p[j] = 0))

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.Trim.lastNonzero_spec
statement:
theorem lastNonzero_spec [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] {p : CPolynomial.Raw R} {k} :
    p.lastNonzero = some k
  → p[k] ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ j, (hj : j < p.size) → j > k → p[j] = 0)

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.Trim.lastNonzero_unique
statement:
lemma lastNonzero_unique [Zero Q] {p : CPolynomial.Raw Q} {k k' : Fin p.size} :
    lastNonzeroProp k → lastNonzeroProp k' → k = k'

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.Trim.non_zero_map
statement:
theorem non_zero_map [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]
    (f : R → R) (hf : ∀ r, f r = 0 → r = 0) (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) :
    let fp := mk (p.map f);
  p.trim = p → fp.trim = fp

lemma push_trim [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] (arr : Array R) (c : R) :

lemma add_coeff_trimmed [LawfulBEq R] (p q : CPolynomial.Raw R) (i : ℕ) :

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.coeff_C_mul_X_pow
statement:
lemma coeff_C_mul_X_pow [LawfulBEq R] (scale : R) (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) (n i : ℕ) :
    (C scale * (p * X ^ n)).coeff i =
      if n ≤ i ∧ i - n < p.size then scale * p.coeff (i - n) else 0

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.coeff_X
statement: lemma coeff_X (i : ℕ) : (X : CPolynomial.Raw R).coeff i = if i = 1 then 1 else 0

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.coeff_add_smul
statement:
lemma coeff_add_smul [LawfulBEq R]  (a b : R) (q : CPolynomial.Raw R) (k : ℕ) :
    (smul (a + b) q).coeff k = (smul a q).coeff k + (smul b q).coeff k

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.coeff_foldl_add
statement:
lemma coeff_foldl_add {α : Type*} [LawfulBEq R]
    (l : List α)
    (f : α → CPolynomial.Raw R)
    (z : CPolynomial.Raw R) (k : ℕ) :
    (l.foldl (fun acc x => acc + f x) z).coeff k
      = z.coeff k + (l.map (fun x => (f x).coeff k)).sum

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.coeff_foldl_addRaw
statement:
lemma coeff_foldl_addRaw {α : Type*} [LawfulBEq R]
    (l : List α)
    (f : α → CPolynomial.Raw R)
    (z : CPolynomial.Raw R) (k : ℕ) :
    (l.foldl (fun acc x => acc.addRaw (f x)) z).coeff k
      = z.coeff k + (l.map (fun x => (f x).coeff k)).sum

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.coeff_monomial
statement:
lemma coeff_monomial [DecidableEq R] {n i : ℕ} {c : R} :
    ((monomial n) c).coeff i = if n = i then c else 0

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.coeff_mul
statement:
lemma coeff_mul [LawfulBEq R] (p q : CPolynomial.Raw R) (k : ℕ) :
    (p * q).coeff k = (p.zipIdx.toList.map (fun ⟨a, i⟩ =>
        ((smul a q).mulPowX i).coeff k)).sum

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.coeff_mulPowX
statement:
lemma coeff_mulPowX [LawfulBEq R] (i : ℕ) (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) (k : ℕ) :
    (p.mulPowX i).coeff k = if k < i then 0 else p.coeff (k - i)

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.coeff_mulPowX'
statement:
lemma coeff_mulPowX' [LawfulBEq R] (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) (n i : ℕ) :
    (p.mulPowX n).coeff i = if i < n then 0 else p.coeff (i - n)

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.coeff_mulPowX_smul_add
statement:
lemma coeff_mulPowX_smul_add [LawfulBEq R] (i : ℕ) (a b : R) (q : CPolynomial.Raw R) (k : ℕ) :
    ((smul (a + b) q).mulPowX i).coeff k =
        ((smul a q).mulPowX i).coeff k + ((smul b q).mulPowX i).coeff k

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.coeff_mul_X_pow
statement:
lemma coeff_mul_X_pow [LawfulBEq R] (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) (n i : ℕ) :
    (p * X ^ n).coeff i =
      if n ≤ i ∧ i - n < p.size then p.coeff (i - n) else 0

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.coeff_mul_eq_sum_range
statement:
lemma coeff_mul_eq_sum_range [LawfulBEq R] (p q : CPolynomial.Raw R) (k : ℕ) (n : ℕ)
    (h : p.size ≤ n) : (p * q).coeff k =
        List.sum ((List.range n).map (fun i => ((smul (p.coeff i) q).mulPowX i).coeff k))

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.coeff_one
statement:
lemma coeff_one (i : ℕ) :
    coeff (1 : CPolynomial.Raw R) i = if i = 0 then 1 else 0

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.coeff_smul_add_distrib
statement:

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.coeff_sum

lemma coeff_zero (i : ℕ) : (0 : CPolynomial.Raw R).coeff i = 0

name: CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw.divByMonic_canonical
statement:

    unfold powBySqUntrimmed
    rw [pow_zero]
    exact Trim.push_trim #[] 1 one_ne_zero

    CPolynomial.divByMonic Q (linearYDivisor f) = (divByLinearY Q f).1
